Builds Workflow

This vignette covers build querying, monitoring, and triggering with onedevr.

library(onedevr)
library(dplyr)

Understanding Build Status

Onedev uses status keywords for filtering, not simple “success/failure” strings.

Available Status Keywords 

# View OneDev's build query language
cat(od_get_query_description("build"))

Common status values:

Status Meaning
successful Build passed all checks
failed Build had failures
errored Build encountered errors
cancelled Build was cancelled
running Build is in progress
waiting Build is queued

Note: Status keywords are case-insensitive. "SUCCESSFUL" and "successful" both work.

Querying Builds

Simple Queries 

# Recent successful builds
success <- od_query_builds(status = "successful", count = 20L)

# Failed builds
failures <- od_query_builds(status = "failed", count = 20L)

# All builds (no filter)
all_builds <- od_query_builds(count = 50L)

Advanced Filtering 

# Builds from specific branch
main_builds <- od_query_builds(
  query = '"Branch" is "main" and "Status" is "successful"',
  count = 20L
)

# Builds by commit
commit_builds <- od_query_builds(
  query = '"Commit" is "abc1234567"',
  count = 10L
)

# Recent builds with errors
errors <- od_query_builds(
  query = '"Status" is "errored" and "Date" is after "2 days ago"',
  count = 50L
)

# See full query syntax
cat(od_get_query_description("build"))

Filtering Results 

# Get all builds and filter locally
all <- od_paginate(
  od_query_builds,
  page_size = 50L,
  max_pages = Inf
)

# Filter by date
recent <- all %>%
  filter(started_date >= Sys.Date() - 7)

# Group by status
by_status <- all %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    avg_duration_mins = mean(duration / 60, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Longest running builds
slow <- all %>%
  arrange(desc(duration)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

Inspecting Builds

Get Build Details 

# Detailed build information
build <- od_get_build(123)

# See structure
str(build)

# Common fields
cat(
  "Build #", build$number, "\n",
  "Status: ", build$status, "\n",
  "Branch: ", build$branch, "\n",
  "Duration: ", build$duration, " seconds\n"
)

Build Parameters 

# Get build parameters (for parameterized builds)
params <- od_get_build_params(123)

# View as data frame
as.data.frame(params)

Build Logs 

# Get build log output
logs <- od_get_build_log(123)

# View log
cat(paste(logs, collapse = "\n"))

# Filter log by pattern
error_lines <- logs %>%
  grep("ERROR|error|Exception", ., value = TRUE)

if (length(error_lines) > 0) {
  cat("Errors found:\n")
  print(error_lines)
}

# Save to file
writeLines(logs, "build-123-log.txt")

Build Details 

# Get detailed build information
build <- od_get_build(123)

# Inspect structure
str(build)

# Access build fields
build$status
build$duration
build$started_date

Build Artifacts

List Artifacts 

# Get all artifacts for a build
artifacts <- od_list_build_artifacts(123)

# View artifact names
artifacts %>%
  select(name, size) %>%
  arrange(desc(size))

Download Artifacts 

# Download a single artifact
od_download_build_artifact(
  build_number = 123,
  artifact_path = "dist/app.zip",
  local_path = "downloaded-app.zip"
)

# Download multiple artifacts
for (artifact in c("dist/app.zip", "reports/coverage.html")) {
  local_file <- basename(artifact)
  od_download_build_artifact(123, artifact, local_file)
  cat("Downloaded:", local_file, "\n")
}

Triggering Builds

Run a Job 

# Run a job by name
od_run_job(
  job_name = "CI",
  branch = "main"
)

# With parameters
od_run_job(
  job_name = "Deploy",
  branch = "main",
  parameters = list(
    ENVIRONMENT = "staging",
    VERBOSE = TRUE,
    VERSION = "1.0.0"
  )
)

Rebuild 

# Rebuild existing build
od_rebuild_job(build_number = 123)

# With additional parameters
od_rebuild_job(
  build_number = 123,
  parameters = list(FORCE_REBUILD = TRUE)
)

Cancel Build 

# Cancel a running build
od_cancel_job(build_number = 123)

# Usually used for running/waiting builds
running <- od_query_builds(status = "running")
if (nrow(running) > 0) {
  purrr::walk(running$number, od_cancel_job)
  cat("Cancelled", nrow(running), "builds\n")
}

Monitoring and Alerts

Track Build Status 

# Function to check build status
check_build_status <- function(build_num, max_wait = 3600) {
  start_time <- Sys.time()

  while (Sys.time() - start_time < max_wait) {
    build <- od_get_build(build_num)

    if (build$status %in% c("successful", "failed", "errored", "cancelled")) {
      return(build)
    }

    Sys.sleep(30)  # Check every 30 seconds
  }

  stop("Build did not complete within ", max_wait, " seconds")
}

# Usage
result <- check_build_status(123, max_wait = 1800)
cat("Build completed with status:", result$status, "\n")

Build Health Dashboard 

# Generate build health summary
build_health <- function(days = 7) {
  recent <- od_paginate(
    od_query_builds,
    page_size = 50L,
    max_pages = 10L
  ) %>%
    filter(started_date >= Sys.Date() - days)

  summary_stats <- recent %>%
    summarise(
      total_builds = n(),
      successful = sum(status == "successful"),
      failed = sum(status == "failed"),
      errored = sum(status == "errored"),
      cancelled = sum(status == "cancelled"),
      success_rate = round(100 * successful / total_builds, 1),
      avg_duration_mins = round(mean(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / 60, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(summary_stats)
}

# Usage
health <- build_health(days = 7)
print(health)

Notification on Failures 

# Function to notify on build failure
notify_on_failure <- function(build_num) {
  build <- od_get_build(build_num)

  if (build$status == "failed") {
    # Send email or notification
    message <- sprintf(
      "Build #%d FAILED\nBranch: %s\nCommit: %s\nDuration: %d mins",
      build$number,
      build$branch,
      build$commit,
      build$duration / 60
    )

    # Use emailer package or similar
    # blastula::compose_email(body = message) %>%
    #   blastula::smtp_send(...)

    cat("ALERT:", message, "\n")
  }
}

Automation Patterns

Continuous Deployment 

# Deploy on successful build
check_and_deploy <- function(build_num) {
  build <- od_get_build(build_num)

  if (build$status == "successful" && build$branch == "main") {
    cat("Build successful. Starting deployment...\n")

    # Download artifacts
    artifacts <- od_list_build_artifacts(build_num)
    for (artifact in artifacts$name) {
      od_download_build_artifact(build_num, artifact, basename(artifact))
    }

    # Deploy (custom logic)
    # system("./deploy.sh")
    cat("Deployment complete\n")
  }
}

Scheduled Build Monitoring 

# Monitor builds periodically
monitor_builds <- function(interval_secs = 300, duration_mins = 120) {
  start_time <- Sys.time()

  while (as.numeric(Sys.time() - start_time) < duration_mins * 60) {
    recent <- od_query_builds(count = 10L)

    # Check for failures
    failures <- recent %>%
      filter(status == "failed")

    if (nrow(failures) > 0) {
      cat("ALERT: Found", nrow(failures), "failed builds\n")
      print(failures %>% select(number, branch, started_date))
    }

    Sys.sleep(interval_secs)
  }
}

Performance Analysis 

# Analyze build performance over time
build_performance <- function(days = 30, job_name = NULL) {
  all_builds <- od_paginate(
    od_query_builds,
    page_size = 100L,
    max_pages = Inf
  ) %>%
    filter(started_date >= Sys.Date() - days)

  if (!is.null(job_name)) {
    all_builds <- all_builds %>%
      filter(job_name == !!job_name)
  }

  performance <- all_builds %>%
    group_by(branch) %>%
    summarise(
      builds = n(),
      avg_duration = mean(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
      median_duration = median(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
      success_rate = sum(status == "successful") / n() * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(builds))

  return(performance)
}

# Usage
perf <- build_performance(days = 30)
print(perf)

Best Practices

  1. Always paginate for production scripts:

    all <- od_paginate(od_query_builds, page_size = 50L, max_pages = Inf)

  2. Cache results to reduce API calls:

    builds_cache <- od_query_builds(count = 100L)
# Reuse cache instead of querying again

  3. Use query syntax for complex filters:

    # More efficient than querying all and filtering
od_query_builds(
  query = '"Status" is "failed" and "Date" is after "yesterday"'
)

  4. Handle timeouts when waiting for builds:

    tryCatch(
  check_build_status(123, max_wait = 300),
  error = function(e) message("Build check timed out: ", e$message)
)

  5. Monitor resource usage for long-running monitors:

    # Periodically check memory usage
if (as.numeric(gc()[2, 6]) > 500) {
  cat("Memory usage high. Consider restarting.\n")
}

Troubleshooting

Q: Build query returns no results but I know builds exist? A: Try removing filters or using od_query_builds(count = 100L) to increase limit.

Q: Status keyword not recognized? A: Run cat(od_get_query_description("build")) to see valid syntax.

Q: Download fails with “artifact not found”? A: Check artifact name exactly with od_list_build_artifacts().

Q: Getting 401/403 when triggering builds? A: Verify API token has buildJob.run permission in OneDev.

For more information, see the getting-started vignette or OneDev API docs at https://your-host/~help/api.
